questions: How do I give a deb822 repo a GPG key from a URL?
Why does deb822_repository fail with missing debian library?
What does the name option control in deb822_repository?
How do I specify a suite as an exact path?

answer_card.title: deb822_repository parameters (part 2)
answer_card.answer_md:
- `name` (required): used for `X-Repolib-Name` and file names of repo and key
- `signed_by`: key URL, keyring path, fingerprint(s), or an ASCII-armored key block
- `suites`: codename (e.g. `bookworm`) or an exact path ending in `/` (then omit components)
- `install_python_debian` (false): install `python3-debian` (system Python only)
- `mode` (0644), `languages`, `pdiffs`, `state`
